name: AnimatedCircularProgress
description: A ring that fills to its value after it appears, with the value in the middle. It can also spin when the amount of work is not known.

value.description: Current value between minValue and maxValue. Ignored while indeterminate.

minValue.description: Value at which the ring is empty.

maxValue.description: Value at which the ring is full.

label.description: Accessible name of the progress bar, for example "Upload progress". Required unless aria-labelledby is given.

size.description: Width and height of the ring in pixels.

thickness.description: Width of the ring stroke in pixels.

showValue.description: Shows the value as text in the middle of the ring.

isIndeterminate.description: Spins a short arc for work of unknown length. No value is announced.

duration.description: Seconds the fill takes, or for one turn while indeterminate. Defaults to 0.9 for the fill and 1.2 for the spin.

isPaused.description: Stops the spinning. The fill still moves to new values, only once.

children.description: Replaces the value text in the middle of the ring.

requirements: Exposes role=progressbar with aria-valuenow, aria-valuemin and aria-valuemax; while indeterminate aria-valuenow is omitted
Needs an accessible name from the label prop or aria-labelledby
The value text is real text in the server HTML, so the final value is readable with no JavaScript and no animation
The fill animates after mount only; visitors who ask for less motion (prefers-reduced-motion), and anything inside rdm-still, see the final ring at once
The spin can be stopped with isPaused (WCAG 2.2.2) and stops for reduced motion
In forced-colors (high contrast) mode the ring uses the system highlight and text colours
Does not flash: nothing changes more than three times in a second (WCAG 2.3.1)
screenReader: Announced as a progress bar with its name and its percentage
The animation is not announced: only the final value is exposed

use_when: A single measurable task such as an upload, a score or a quota
A compact progress display where a bar would not fit
avoid_when: Several steps with names, where a stepper tells more
Work that finishes in under a second
anti_patterns: Leaving the label off, which gives screen readers an unnamed progress bar
Showing a spinning ring for work that has a known amount
